title: CRASH-062: user error handler recursive compile corrupts CG state uaf (use-after-free)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free at main/streams/streams.c:276 in _php_stream_free when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src 2e1a2438b5e6, which postdates the release, and names the defect at Zend/zend_execute_API.c:282 (premature zend_destroy_rsrc_list in shutdown_executor, run before Zend/zend.c:822 shutdown_compiler); claimed site Zend/zend.c:975 is real but is only the semantics bug
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build completes it natively, so an arm that completes it saw nothing.
fault_sites_why: ASan's access stack in our native run (results-ours-asan-default.json, sha256 045e3366bfc5) has _php_stream_free at main/streams/streams.c:276 as its first frame inside PHP's tree (frame #0); the stack's remaining frames are the interpreter's dispatch and are not sites

virtual-malloc.oracle: the case on the virtual profile with the nested layer present but returning every freed block's loan, so only musl mallocng revokes, per BLOCK, when PHP's cache hands a block back to free(): a fault at the ASan site, or the trigger ends and this arm did not see it (tools/arms.json php-real-block)
virtual-malloc.verdict_note: cause=25 pc=0x3f99dd9db0 in _php_stream_free; by function: _php_stream_free at main/streams/streams.c:276 is the function this case declares (fault_sites, ASan frame #0 of our native run), at ASan's own line

virtual-nested-pools.oracle: the same image with the nested allocator layer retiring the payload at EVERY _efree, cache-absorbed or not, and re-deriving it under a fresh node when the cache hands the block to its next tenant: a fault at the ASan site, or the trigger ends and this arm did not see it (php-real-object)
virtual-nested-pools.verdict_note: cause=25 pc=0x3f8c1d9db0 in _php_stream_free; by function: _php_stream_free at main/streams/streams.c:276 is the function this case declares (fault_sites, ASan frame #0 of our native run), at ASan's own line

virtual-nested-exact.oracle: virtual-nested-pools with each payload bounded to the caller's request instead of REAL_SIZE(n): the arm that can see a defect inside PHP's own rounding slack (php-real-exact)

status: built 2026-10-27 from the corpus and our native oracle; what has run is in this record's arms (verdict, verdict_from) and under results/
note: population: asan-blind -- ASan reports it only with PHP's allocator patched (cache off, no 8-byte rounding); with zend_alloc.c as shipped the run reads EXIT:255, PHP's own fatal error, with no detector report. That is the selection, by measurement; which mechanism hides it, and which arm sees it, is what the arms record. Collected by the corpus as history-5.x (historical-known, confidence high).
